questions.question: Which TWO are examples of management OF the cloud?

options.text: Automatically scaling resources based on demand

options.why: That is management IN the cloud (an interface).

options.text: Monitoring health and automatically replacing failing resources

options.why: That is management IN the cloud (an interface).

questions.explanation: Management of the cloud is about what happens to resources (scale, templates, monitoring, auto-replace, alerts).

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of management IN the cloud?

options.text: Using Azure PowerShell to manage resources
options.why: Correct. It is a management interface.
That is management OF the cloud.
That is management OF the cloud.
That is management OF the cloud in Microsoft's description.

questions.explanation: Management in the cloud refers to the tools you use: portal, CLI, PowerShell, APIs.

questions.question: Which tool provides a browser-based command line with Azure CLI and Azure PowerShell already installed?

options.why: Storage Explorer is a desktop app for storage.

questions.explanation: Cloud Shell runs in the browser, already authenticated, with CLI and PowerShell.

questions.question: Defining infrastructure in files that can be version-controlled and deployed repeatably is called what?

options.why: SaaS is a cloud service type.

questions.explanation: IaC (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform) makes deployments repeatable and reviewable.
